t: A Nubian kingdom on the Nile south of Egypt, centred first at Napata and later at Meroe.
Its kings conquered Egypt and ruled it as the Twenty-Fifth Dynasty, then built an iron-working, pyramid-building civilisation at Meroe.
Shifting trade, environmental strain and pressure from Aksum ended Kush as a unified state by the mid-fourth century CE.
dyk: The Kushites built more pyramids, at El-Kurru, Nuri and Meroe, than were built in Egypt itself.
ev: Piye defeats the Delta coalition of Tefnakht and records his triumph at Jebel Barkal
The Assyrian king Esarhaddon takes Memphis
Ashurbanipal's army sacks Thebes, ending Kushite rule in Egypt
An Egyptian army under Psamtik II raids Nubia
The royal centre's move south to Meroe is complete
Kush raids Roman Egypt; Petronius' punitive expedition ends in a peace favourable to Kush
King Ezana of Aksum records an invasion of Kush along the Nile
